verdict.rationale: Bruno CLI runs whole API collections from the command line, including in Docker and CI/CD pipelines [bruno-docs-1, bruno-docs-18, bruno-docs-30]. It produces test reports in JSON, JUnit, and HTML [bruno-docs-2], and Bruno supports assertions and test suites with data-driven runs [bruno-docs-32], so the core story is covered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of collection runs and report output, and explicit documentation of pass/fail exit codes and summary semantics.
